findings.description: The Agency branch only projects legacy Agency state and then calls milestone_executor(), which is a constant-return helper; it never persists or reads the canonical delivery aggregate nor invokes the Agency-to-Orchestrator handoff path. The assertions can therefore pass if the actual approved-milestone delegation regresses or is absent.
findings.fix: Exercise the real approved-milestone transition that writes/reads canonical delivery state and assert its persisted executor/approval fields, rather than projecting state and asserting a constant helper.

findings.description: The direct-path defined_goal evidence is a hard-coded payload literal, not derived from the defined-goal input or persisted state, so this test cannot prove that Orchestrator starts from a defined goal.
findings.fix: Pass a concrete defined goal through the production direct-entry surface and assert the resulting state/trajectory derives from it while Agency discovery remains inactive.
